drawings.description: croquis au crayon, au-dessus du trait : un $X'$ biffé d'où partent deux flèches vers $Y$, trois $\Omega$ dont un biffé, et un mot illisible sous le trait
drawings.kind: pencil sketch above a line: X' struck, arrows, Omegas, diagonal strokes
drawings.notes: Pencil, redrawn on tight crops. Top left: the square Y~ - X~ over Y - X with two downward arrows. Top centre: the heavily overwritten letter at the source of the two arrows (the struck X' of the transcription; on the facsimile it reads X rather than X', the prime being on the letter written above it) is left out as struck; a small hooked stroke goes from it up to X' (with its prime), and the two arrows go right towards Y. Two short pencil strokes and a small S-shaped stroke below them (unread) are drawn. Three long diagonal strokes down to the horizontal line (the first crosses it, the second stops at the illegible word just above it, the third stops just above it); the strokes are slightly concave and drawn as smooth curves, Omega^1 and Omega^1_{X'/Y'} (preceded by a dash; the struck symbol before the dash is left out) beside the second stroke, Omega^1_{X/Y} lower left. Left out: the illegible word (it sits just above the line, at the foot of the second diagonal, not under it), the typed text showing through from the back. Still a reading: the letters of Omega^1_{X'/Y'} and the role of the struck letter. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
